Let me note what the one CA-looking file is, so I'm not overlooking an available trust anchor.

```python
import ssl, re

p = '/tmp/abb-ca-bundle.pem'
try:
    with open(p, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    certs = re.findall(rb'-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----.*?-----END CERTIFICATE-----', data, re.S)
    print(f"{p}: {len(data)} bytes, {len(certs)} PEM certificate block(s)")
    print("first-block subject preview:")
    print(certs[0][:200].decode(errors='replace') if certs else "(no PEM blocks)")
except Exception as e:
    print("unreadable:", e)
```
